content:
maya (PM): proposing a 3-week prioritization sprint with ~8 active design partners (mix of hosted, dedicated, private) to collect longitudinal feedback and triage asks into the Q2 roadmap. Goals: surface top-3 product gaps, validate launch risks, get 20 canonical prompts + 5 failing cases. Want to align on recruitment cadence and how we weight asks from partners vs internal roadmap commitments. Thoughts? :eyes:

sam (Eng): +1 to the sprint idea. curious about bandwidth — do we expect eng to take on fixes during the 3 weeks or just gather evidence for a prioritized backlog? also: request we define "failing cases" clearly (perf, quality, e2e infra).

maya (PM): plan is observational + quick triage: week1 capture, week2 synth + small fixes/mitigations (safety/rollbacks), week3 final prioritization + ship list. small fixes = <8 engineer-days each. anything bigger goes to backlog.

leo (Design): recommend we run a short usability pulse after week1 for any UX regressions on streaming & function-calling flows. we should provide partners with a short checklist + recorder to capture steps. can draft checklist.

frances (Research): for weighting asks, propose a simple rubric: severity (user-facing impact 1-5), frequency (sampled from partner telemetry 1-5), alignment to strategy (reduces cost/latency or unlocks new use-case 1-5). multiply for a score. we'll collect qualitative quotes too.

maya (PM): love the rubric. suggest we surface two buckets: "blocker/launch" (must-fix pre-rollout) and "post-launch high priority". blockers require both severity>=4 and frequency>=3 or security/compliance.

sam (Eng): ops question — for dedicated/private partners, can we instrument telemetry to quantify frequency across their workloads? need opt-in consent + a lightweight SDK snippet.

maya (PM): yes — we'll include an opt-in telemetry shim. sample message for partners: "If you opt in we’ll collect anonymized request latency, error codes, and prompt hashes to prioritize fixes."

leo (Design): on recruitment: target 4 hosted, 2 dedicated, 2 private (airgapped or VPC). duration: committed reps for 3 weeks (2-3 async touchpoints/wk + one 1-hour sync). incentives: $3k credit + early rollout priority.

frances (Research): data capture plan: canonical prompt set (20 prompts), failing-case recordings (5 each), short weekly NPS + 3 open questions, and telemetry. we'll provide a template spreadsheet and a short script to run locally for private partners.

maya (PM): logistics checklist (can we commit?):
- recruitment message + opt-in form (maya)
- onboarding kit + checklist (leo)
- telemetry shim + consent text (sam)
- rubric + analysis workbook (frances)
- ops playbook for quick mitigations (eng-oncall runbook)

sam (Eng): I can prep the shim + a deployable snippet. rough ETA 5 working days. will aim for minimal deps and a toggle flag. snippet example to share with partners:
```
// telemetry shim (pseudo)
fetch("https://r-infer.telemetry/collect", {
  method: 'POST',
  body: JSON.stringify({latency_ms, status_code, prompt_hash}),
  headers: { 'x-r-infer-optin': 'true' }
})
```

leo (Design): I’ll draft the checklist and pulse survey by EOW. includes UX/edge-case repro steps and request for screen recordings.

frances (Research): will build the rubric spreadsheet and example scoring. also recommend a morning triage huddle mid-sprint (15 min) to surface any blockers that might become "blockers" for launch.

maya (PM): agree to mid-sprint triage. final question: success criteria for this sprint? propose:
- definitive top-3 prioritized items with owners and est. effort
- 20 canonical prompts collected and validated
- at least 2 quick mitigations shipped (<=8 engineer-days each) or rolled into firm commitments with timelines
- partner satisfaction: average weekly pulse >= 7/10

sam (Eng): sounds reasonable. add: actionable rollback plan documented for any mitigations we ship.

ops-bot: Reminder — please add the sprint epic to the R-Board and tag the oncall rotation.

maya (PM): great — i'll open the recruitment form and a sprint epic today. tagging people here: @sam (Eng) @leo (Design) @frances (Research) — please confirm EOW deliverables. :thumbsup:
